data.name: Nousha
data.gender_notes: Nousha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'naws' meaning 'to be light' or 'to be radiant'. Named for the brightness and luminousness of the soul, or for the radiant light of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Nousha carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nousha usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the light of faith and guidance in Islam.
data.etymology: Nousha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nousha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
